_about: Project-type limits for council DCP rules that are for one kind of project (signs, shops/commercial, industry) but were tagged for every type (config_all). Read by scripts/gate_rules_devtypes.py, re-applied after every publish by gate_rules.apply_gate_rules. A row is matched by council + chapter + text fingerprint (never_serve.text_key), so a re-extraction that mints new ids keeps the limit. Only rows currently tagged {ALL} with v2_dev_type_source='config_all' are changed; config_declined, text_regex, specific and never-serve rows are never touched. Source: Haiku 5.5 'applies when' labels (ce-applies-when-2026-11-07 corpus, rows labelled 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-20), project_types only; wrong-for-project-type rule shown to every house (served-answer audit 2026-11-20). Approved by the owner 2026-11-20.
